title: Monster Mosh
html:
Quest Giver: Tipper Gourd

Quest Type: Kill

Quest Description: Go to Z'lash's Pad found off of the Mutanous Malaise. Once there, kill 50 Poison Grunt Moshers and kill Gr'Aves, Chuhdd, D'Oyle, and Pvvnly. Once completed, return to Tipper Gourd in Mutanous Malaise Mezzanine.

Quest Reward: Gold and 1 King's Coin

Return to: Tipper Gourd

Repeatable: No

Following Quest: Monsters Moshing

Zone: The Mutanous Malaise

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Go to Z'lash's Pad found off of the Mutanous Malaise. Once there, kill 50 Poison Grunt Moshers and kill Gr'Aves, Chuhdd, D'Oyle, and Pvvnly. Once completed, return to Tipper Gourd in Mutanous Malaise Mezzanine.

Offer:

I cannot believe what I'm hearing. It is just awful. This kind of behavior erodes the very moral fiber of our town. If this spreads, this kind of infectious commotion could turn our lovely community into a cesspool of deviant activities. There are monsters down in Mutanous Malaise thrashing about, knocking into each other, flailing about with their limbs, and jumping off rocks just to crash into each other. They're calling this behavior 'Monster Moshing.' Have you ever heard of something so despicable? I don't even know what a 'Mosh' is, but I'm outraged. It's clearly becoming out of control and on the verge of becoming a social plague. There is a group of misfits that have formed a band in Z'lash's Pad. They have created a song dedicated to this vile act to spread news of the craze and influence others into performing these blatantly lascivious acts.

That is why I'm forming a Citizen Action Committee, so that we can put an end to this indecency. And as the self-appointed Chairwoman of this committee, I'm nominating you as our Sergeant-at-Arms. I want you to get down there and put a stop to this smashing and flailing.

I need you to go down to Z'lash's Pad and put an end to the misfits named Gr'Aves, Chuhdd, D'Oyle, and Pvvnly before they influence more monsters and they succumb to this 'Moshing' madness. Z'lash's Pad can be found by exploring the first level of Mutanous Malaise. Once you are done, find me, Tipper Gourd, in The Mutanous Malaise Mezzanine.

Turn-in:

Bless your soul, sweety. Those Oroks just about worked my last nerve. All of this tension has given me a headache. I just might be able to rest now, knowing that innocent people will no longer have to be subjected to this mindless ballyhoo. But good people can never rest on their laurels. Come see me when you are ready to keep up the fight for decency.

Objectives:

  • Gr'Aves
  • Chuhdd
  • D'Oyle
  • Pvvnly
  • Poison Grunt Moshers

Level range: 35–50
